# Swimlane (cross-functional flow)

**Use when:** a process crosses people, teams or systems and the hand-offs between them matter.

## Purpose
A flowchart split into lanes, one per actor (role, department or system), in the
spirit of BPMN pools and lanes. The reader sees who does what and every hand-off,
which is where processes break.

## Spec settings
- `"type": "swimlane"`, `"layout": "swimlane-lr"` (lanes stacked, time flows left to
  right). `swimlane-tb` for narrow pages (lanes side by side, time flows down).
- Every group is `"kind": "lane"`; every node sits in exactly one lane (`[lane]`).

## Lanes
- 2-6 lanes. Name them by role or team, not person: `Customer`, `Sales`, `Finance`,
  `ERP System`.
- Order lanes by first involvement: the initiator on top (or left).
- Systems may have lanes when they act on their own (scheduled jobs, automations).
- Do not nest lanes; do not put non-lane groups around lanes.

## Node kinds
Same as flowchart: `start`, `end`, `process` (verb + object), `decision`, `document`,
`data`, `manual`, `subprocess`. One start in the initiator's lane.

## Edges
- Sequence edges unlabeled; decision branches labeled `yes`/`no` or the condition.
- Hand-offs between lanes are the point of the diagram: label them with what is
  handed over when not obvious (`signed contract`, `invoice`).
- `dashed` for messages/notifications that do not block (email, event).

## Checklist
- [ ] Each lane is one actor; 2-6 lanes; initiator first
- [ ] Every node is in a lane
- [ ] One start, at least one end
- [ ] Decisions have labeled branches
- [ ] Hand-offs visible and labeled where they carry a document

## Common mistakes
- Nodes outside lanes, or lanes as `generic` groups (they won't render as lanes).
- A lane per person instead of per role.
- Lanes with a single trivial step: merge or drop the actor.
- Many back-and-forth hand-offs: often a sign the process itself needs fixing - show it.

## Example
```json
{
  "title": "Purchase Approval",
  "subtitle": "Requests over $5,000 - Finance policy FP-12, 2026",
  "type": "swimlane",
  "layout": "swimlane-lr",
  "groups": [
    {"id": "employee", "label": "Employee", "kind": "lane"},
    {"id": "manager", "label": "Manager", "kind": "lane"},
    {"id": "finance", "label": "Finance", "kind": "lane"}
  ],
  "nodes": [
    {"id": "start", "label": "Need Identified", "kind": "start", "group": "employee"},
    {"id": "request", "label": "Submit Request", "kind": "process", "group": "employee"},
    {"id": "review", "label": "Review Request", "kind": "process", "group": "manager"},
    {"id": "approve", "label": "Approved?", "kind": "decision", "group": "manager"},
    {"id": "revise", "label": "Revise Request", "kind": "process", "group": "employee"},
    {"id": "po", "label": "Issue Purchase Order", "kind": "document", "group": "finance"},
    {"id": "done", "label": "PO Sent", "kind": "end", "group": "finance"}
  ],
  "edges": [
    {"source": "start", "target": "request"},
    {"source": "request", "target": "review", "label": "request form"},
    {"source": "review", "target": "approve"},
    {"source": "approve", "target": "po", "label": "yes"},
    {"source": "approve", "target": "revise", "label": "no"},
    {"source": "revise", "target": "review"},
    {"source": "po", "target": "done"}
  ]
}
```
